verdict.rationale: Increase offers building blocks rather than turnkey risk controls. Account Holds reduce available balance and can later be released, though they are documented for reserving funds for known future activity rather than suspicious activity. ACH transfers can optionally be held for approval by another team member. Card authorizations can be approved or declined in real time via webhooks, so ops teams could write their own limit logic. Missing for 10: built-in per-account and per-program transaction and velocity limits, holds triggered by suspicious activity, account freeze capability, documented reinstatement paths, and independent corroboration.
